rows.definition: localContextRetry is the HTTPPlanner method in internal/agent/tool_result_budget.go that decides whether a failed call to a local endpoint should be compacted and resent exactly once, because the endpoint refused the prompt as too large and this call is not already the compacted retry.
rows.distinction: The RETRY DECISION for one failed call on a local endpoint - not compaction (the history-rewrite mechanism the retry applies) and not CompactionView (the lossy savings model), and not localContextRefusal (the status-and-body matcher that recognizes the 502 the serve returns).
